title: Coefficient of multiplication by the indeterminate
statement: Let $>0$, let $m$ and $a$ be binary vectors of length $$, and let $d$ be a natural number. Write $a_d$ for the $d$th coefficient of $a$, taking it to be zero when $d\ge $; write $a_{d-1}$ for the shifted coefficient, taking it to be zero when $d=0$; and let $a_{-1}$ be the top coefficient of $a$. Extend $m$ by setting its coefficient at degree $$ to $1$ and all coefficients above that to $0$. Then the $d$th coefficient of the vector obtained by multiplying by the indeterminate modulo this monic polynomial is $a_{d-1}+a_{-1}m_d$, with arithmetic in the field of two elements.
